evidence_span.text: Thus, SDCCAG8 mutations are sufficient to cause BBS in 1-2% of our combined cohorts, and define this gene as the sixteenth BBS locus (BBS16).

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: patient mutations establish SDCCAG8 as a causal BBS gene, but the study provides incomplete support for its specific ciliary mechanism. The human disease context is indirect to postnatal mouse brain endothelium.

evidence_span.text: GRSF1 maintains branched-chain amino acid homeostasis and mitochondrial function by stabilizing BCKDHB (branched-chain keto acid dehydrogenase E1 subunit β) mRNA at the post-transcriptional level.

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: gene-specific perturbation and molecular data support BCKDHB as the E1β component involved in BCAA homeostasis. The cardiac and cardiomyocyte context is indirect to brain endothelial cells.

evidence_span.text: Our findings indicate a role for Cc2d2a in vesicle trafficking of transmembrane outer segment components such as opsins, based on the striking accumulation of vesicles and mislocalization of opsins in mutant photoreceptors.

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: Cc2d2a mutant data support a transition-zone-associated role in trafficking proteins into the ciliary compartment. Zebrafish photoreceptors and other ciliated cells are indirect to mouse brain endothelium.

evidence_span.text: In ciliated cells, we observe localization of recombinant CC2D2A at the basal body and colocalization with CEP290, whose cognate gene is mutated in multiple hereditary ciliopathies.

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: the paper supports CC2D2A localization and function at the cilium/basal body, but does not specifically establish transition-zone localization. Human ciliopathy and zebrafish kidney evidence are indirect, making the declared partial context overclaimed.
